Entry is charged per participant. Meal passes are optional.

  • Professional Rs 800 per participant
  • Meal pass Rs 200 each, optional

W-4.body:
Register your team

Fill in the form and send it to register@example.com. One lead registers the whole team.

  • Pick your track and ticket type.
  • Tell us how many participants are in your team (1 to 4).
  • Add meal passes if you want them.

Team registration

Web Track allows 1 to 4. AI and Hardware tracks need 2 to 4.

Sending opens your email app with the details addressed to register@example.com.

W-5.body:
Sign up as a mentor

Want to help teams build? Fill in the mentor form and send it to mentors@example.com. This is separate from team registration.

  • Choose your area of expertise: Web, AI or Hardware.
  • Tell us if you are free Saturday, Sunday or both days.

Mentor sign-up

Sending opens your email app with the details addressed to mentors@example.com.
